end.summary:
Estimated collections using a known group as a guide.
Practised deciding whether estimates were close to or far from the actual number.
Identified that spreading objects changes their appearance, not the number.
The spread-out-row misconception was corrected by the end of the lesson.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using a known group to estimate collections and comparing estimates with actual numbers. Ananya explained that 20 is far from 43 and that 30 is close to 32. They first judged spread-out bangles as more numerous, then corrected this by saying the bangles would still number 8 when counted. At home, spread out a small group of safe objects and ask Ananya to estimate, count, and explain whether the estimate was close or far.
